parsed.summary: After tracing the power tree (XT60 -> 10 mΩ shunt R71 -> MIC26903 5 V buck with 15 µH inductor and 6.8 k/1.3 k divider -> LD39200PU33R 3V3 LDO), the two MCUs (STM32H753VITx / STM32F405RGTx), the I2C sensor set (BMI088 0x19/0x69, IIS2MDCTR 0x1E, MPRLS 0x18, TMP100 0x4E, EEPROMs 0x50, INA219 0x40), the PCA9685/FLASH/EEPROM on the FCC bus, the CH330 USB-UART bridges, the 25 MHz crystals and the FCC<->NAVC UART/I2C/GPIO link, the drawing matches the specification. The only textual mismatches (PCA9685 noted at 0x41 vs the spec table's 0x40, and GPS VCC on 3V3 vs the spec's '5 V feeds the GPS module') are internally required corrections — the spec's PCA9685=0x40 would collide with the INA219=0x40 on the same bus, and the MAX-8Q VCC range is 2.7-3.6 V — so they are spec transcription slips, not board deviations. The barometer RESET/EOC swap is the documented V1 bug, not an anomaly.
